_notes: Each device's use, recorded by running UQM 0.8.0's own InvokeDevice (planets/devices.c, as DoManipulateDevices calls it on select) in tools/extract/golden/devices.c's use mode. Code only.

Each scenario: the device (globdata.h's number), where the ship is (the activity, in a world's orbit, the system's generator, the world orbited by planet and moon (-1: the planet), what StartSphereTracking (ILWRATH_SHIP) answers, the race of the system's first group, a hyperspace group near, the fuel in 1/100 units), the story fields set before (the rest 0), and what came of it: the status (0 DEVICE_FAILURE, 1 DEVICE_SUCCESS, 2 DEVICE_SUCCESS_NO_SOUND), the story fields it changed, START_ENCOUNTER set (encounter), CHECK_LOAD in NextActivity (load: the fake load of a device's talk), IN_BATTLE left (battle; it starts set), CrewEnlisted (65535: (COUNT)~0, the game over) and the fuel after, and the calls made in order: ["sound", n] PlayMenuSound, ["fade", kind, time] FadeScreen (ScreenFadeType's number, ticks of ONE_SECOND 840), ["sleep"] SleepThreadUntil, ["sphere", race] StartSphereTracking, ["put", offset, mode] PutGroupInfo, ["reinit"] ReinitQueue of the system's groups, ["clone", race] CloneShipFragment, ["savesys"] SaveSolarSysLocation, ["savehyper"] SaveSisHyperState.
